content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Gumroad payhip

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is base-layer architecture that gives you full ownership of your digital storefront. It’s not a workaround or a plugin—it’s a complete stack of tools that handle hosting, payment processing, order storage, and file delivery. Unlike platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, which rely on Stripe or PayPal, this infrastructure uses open-source and decentralized components. The result? You’re no longer at the mercy of payment processors that exclude your country or platforms that can suspend your account without warning. It’s commerce infrastructure you own, control, and deploy yourself.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack is built on four core components: hosting, backend logic, order storage, and payment processing. For hosting, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve your storefront for free. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which process orders and trigger file delivery. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, and files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payments are processed through NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. This architecture is modular, meaning you can swap components as needed without rebuilding the entire system.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and similar platforms are unavailable or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, or software but can’t collect payment through conventional tools, this is for you. It’s also for creators who want to own their infrastructure instead of renting it. By deploying this stack, you eliminate platform fees, account suspensions, and geographic restrictions. You’re not just selling products—you’re building a commerce system that works on your terms, in your country, with your rules.
Stripe operates in only 46 countries—sovereign infrastructure works in all 195.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component in the stack serves a specific purpose. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront for free, ensuring it’s always online. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, processing orders and triggering file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver your digital products instantly. NOWPayments handles crypto payments, firing a webhook the moment payment confirms on-chain. Together, these components form a seamless system that operates without relying on third-party platforms or payment processors.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure, start by choosing your stack components based on your technical comfort level. If you’re new to this, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a fully configured solution deployed in 48 hours, including end-to-end testing and 30-day support. Alternatively, you can follow the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) to deploy the stack yourself using the provided documentation and source code. Once deployed, load your products, configure your payment settings, and launch your storefront. The result is a fully operational digital store that you own and control, free from platform restrictions and payment processor limitations.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, deploy sovereign commerce infrastructure using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This stack eliminates reliance on Stripe or PayPal, giving you full control over your storefront and payment processing. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10.
PayPal can hold your funds for 180 days—crypto payments settle on-chain in minutes.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re looking for a Stripe alternative in Nigeria or a way to sell digital products without Gumroad, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a fully deployed solution in 48 hours. It includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, with 5 products loaded and SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured. For a DIY approach, explore the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) or Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Choose your hosting platform: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Configure order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets. Upload your digital products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Test your storefront end-to-end to ensure all components work together. Deploy your stack and load your products. Configure email delivery settings with SPF/DKIM/DMARC if needed. Launch your storefront and start selling.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is fully deployed for you in 48 hours, requiring no technical expertise. Alternatively, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides step-by-step documentation for self-deployment.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and stablecoins on networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON for low-fee transactions.
How do I handle refunds with crypto payments?
Refunds are processed manually by sending the equivalent crypto amount back to the buyer’s wallet. Document your refund policy clearly on your storefront.
Can I scale this infrastructure as my business grows?
Yes. The stack is designed to scale. Upgrade to paid tiers of Supabase or Cloudflare Workers as needed, and optimize file delivery with CDN integrations.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments operates on a decentralized blockchain network, minimizing downtime. If issues arise, payments are queued and processed once the network stabilizes.
